impact: Tighter Korean policy lifts local funding costs and can support the won; mildly negative for rate-sensitive Korean telecoms like SKM, neutral to slightly positive for memory names already rebounding.
summary: The Bank of Korea raised its base rate by 25 basis points to 3.25% at its final meeting of the year on Nov 26, following August's hike to 3%. The Kospi still closed up 0.29% at about 4,711 after Wednesday's 6.2% chip rout, with SK Hynix up 2.2% and Samsung up 0.35%.
title: Bank of Korea hikes 25bp to 3.25%, back-to-back move; Kospi edges up
